_comment: sample-data 3.0.0 SqlTable predicates, Serializer 1.0.2-beta config schema (Truvio.Commerce.Serializer docs/configuration.md 'SqlTable predicate fields', lines 178-211). Intended home: layers/sample-data/config/sample-data-2.4.json, unioned by Compose-Edition keyed mode|name (Compose-Edition.ps1:715-745). Every predicate is Merge: the layer ships only its own FIXT* / PACK-RPP-* / PACK-BOM-* / PACK-SUB-* rows and the two contract-anchored users. FK-safe order (parents first), which is also the harvest order; the engine re-sorts by sys.foreign_keys at deserialize. WHERE clauses use only LIKE / IN / OR / AND and column identifiers, which the where validator accepts (docs/sql-tables.md:111-146). No nameColumn: file names are the PK joined with $$, keeping the base and cross-layer filename collision checks meaningful (base.contract.json:178-188; Validate-Distribution.ps1:151-179). Underscore keys are annotations. NEVER add a predicate for dbo._demoClock, _demoClockExclusion, _demoClockGuard, EmailMessage-marker rows or ScheduledTask 'Truvio demo clock' here: config load validates every SqlTable predicate's table against INFORMATION_SCHEMA (ConfigLoader.cs:217-223, SqlIdentifierValidator.cs:36-46), so a predicate on a table that exists only after a local SQL script breaks config load on every online host.

predicates.name: sample-data AccessUser
predicates._why: Buyer 1328 IMCUser and CSR 1326 IMCSalesrep at the exact ids the base contract names (base.contract.json:70-89). Written with IDENTITY_INSERT (SqlTableWriter.cs:46-48, 73-76). Groups 1325/1270/1292 are NOT here: the base replace tree owns them (base config swift-2.4.json:134-139). Every excluded column was measured on DW 10.28.10; AccessUserPasswordSalt is absent on that build and must not be listed. Merge keeps a password set by UserSetPassword on every re-delivery.

predicates.name: sample-data AccessUserGroupRelation
predicates._why: Memberships 1328 -> 1325 Customers and 1326 -> 1292 CSR (identities.sql:91-100). Natural-pair PK on 10.28.10.

predicates.name: sample-data EcomGroups
predicates._why: 3 fixture groups (catalog.sql:80-84) + 5 feature fixture groups (feature-fixtures.sql:53-57). The PACK group ids are listed exactly, as the script deletes them (feature-fixtures.sql:49), rather than by prefix.

predicates.name: sample-data EcomShopGroupRelation
predicates._why: Merge, never Replace: the table is base-owned replaceWholeTable (base.contract.json:152-168). Adds only the 8 SHOP1 bindings under this layer's keys, as truvio-demo 1.8.0 does for TCGRP-*.

predicates.name: sample-data EcomProducts
predicates.where: ProductId LIKE 'FIXT%' OR ProductId LIKE 'PACK-RPP-%' OR ProductId LIKE 'PACK-BOM-%' OR ProductId LIKE 'PACK-SUB-%'
predicates._why: 14 masters + 6 Size variant rows (catalog.sql:88-133) + 8 feature fixture products (feature-fixtures.sql:67-82) = 28. GETDATE stamps and host-born ProductUniqueId values freeze at harvest.

predicates.name: sample-data EcomGroupProductRelation
predicates.where: GroupProductRelationProductId LIKE 'FIXT%' OR GroupProductRelationProductId LIKE 'PACK-RPP-%' OR GroupProductRelationProductId LIKE 'PACK-BOM-%' OR GroupProductRelationProductId LIKE 'PACK-SUB-%'

predicates.name: sample-data EcomVariantOptionsProductRelation
predicates._why: FIXT0013 and FIXT0014 x FIXTVO1-3 (catalog.sql:122-132). Natural-pair PK on 10.28.10; identity-PK builds match by the natural pair (IdentityPkRelationTables.cs:39-40).

predicates.name: sample-data EcomPrices
predicates._why: Qty ladder T05/T10/T25 + FIXT-PRICE-CONTRACT (catalog.sql:136-139) + PACK-RPP-0001..0004 (feature-fixtures.sql:104-107) = 8. Needs Serializer >= 1.0.2-beta so unset nullable columns stay NULL on merge (issue #18).

predicates.name: sample-data EcomProductItems
predicates._why: The two BOM slots on PACK-BOM-0001 (feature-fixtures.sql:96-99) the bom-cart-lines probe selects (layers/feature-bom-configurator/layer.json:22-40).

predicates.name: sample-data EcomOrders
predicates._why: The delivered order FIXT-ORDER-RMA1 for buyer 1328 (catalog.sql:155-156). Excluded columns are session and token columns the script never sets (measured on 10.28.10). OrderDate -30 days and OrderCompletedDate -28 days freeze at harvest.

predicates.name: sample-data EcomOrderLines
predicates._why: FIXT-ORDER-RMA1-1 (catalog.sql:157-158); sys FK child of EcomOrders.

predicates.name: sample-data EcomRmaOrderLines
predicates._why: The RMA-to-order-line link (catalog.sql:159-160). Identity-only PK RmaOrderLineId (measured): harvest ONLY after the source-host rekey to 100301 (plan.md (d) step 13). The engine writes the id verbatim and never remaps it; the name carries no 'Relation', so no collision warning fires (SqlTableProvider.cs:407-411). Selected by its own order-line key, never by RmaOrderLineRmaId, which is feature-rma's key.
